title: A Tiny One Bedroom House
description: A small single bedroom house with living room, kitchen, bathroom and bedroom. A verandah in the front and a nice terrace at the back to relax and enjoy the outdoors

title: Blank plot
description: Empty 30 × 40 ft plot with a single floor slab. Best when you want to build your house entirely from scratch.

title: Family home (parametric)
description: Fully-parametric Konkan family home: front verandah, three bedrooms, two bathrooms, central hall (Majghar), living, kitchen, passage and a rear Padvi under a hip roof with a loft. Resize the plot and the rooms re-flow. Default 40 × 52 ft.

title: Large Country House
description: Large four bedroom bungalow with open central courtyard, master bedroom with walk in wardrobe, attached bathrooms for all bedrooms, Verandah and terraces to enjoy the outdoors on all sides. Customizable to a two bedroom single floor option.

title: Single-story cottage
description: Fully-parametric Konkan cottage: front verandah, bedroom, central hall (Majghar), living, kitchen, bathroom, and a rear Padvi — hip roof. Resize the plot and the rooms re-flow. Default 30 × 46 ft.

title: Two Storeyed Five Bedroom Villa
description: Five bedroom villa. Upper floor designed to be let out as three individual bedrooms with attached bathroom. Ground floor residence with 2BHK
